en: A sepia-toned postcard view over a town with dense rooftops and trees in the foreground, dominated by a large Gothic cathedral-like church and a castle complex on a hill. A tall tree frames the right side of the scene, and another tower with a dome stands on the far right. At the bottom border of the image there is printed German text identifying the view of Meissen and the Albrechtsburg castle and cathedral.
